content.text: The current model already preserves ordered child records and transactional inventory revisions, but export is still assembled in the browser and there is no restore boundary. I’m adding a dedicated version-1 server backup contract, an in-memory short-lived preview store, and a single SQLite replacement transaction; the browser will only download and submit through those APIs.

The initial implementation is in place: export now originates entirely from SQLite, preview validates an exact-shape immutable reconstruction, and confirmation replaces the complete dataset at one expected revision. I’m compiling and linting now to catch contract and UI integration errors before adding focused coverage and documentation.
